title: Special Episode Trips
description: A list of places that appear in two special episodes: “Three-Wheel Bike”, which was included with the Heya Camp release, and “Lake Inaga Trip”, which was originally exclusive to special volume 13.5 but was later animated and released after Season 3.

title: Heya Camp
description: A miniseries released after Season 1. The story follows the OEC members on a journey across various places in Yamanashi and Shizuoka Prefectures to complete a stamp rally.

title: Yuru Camp Movie
description: A movie released in 2022. Set in the future, the story follows the characters as they reunite and begin a project to restore and reopen an abandoned campground.

title: Miscellaneous Places
description: A list of character homes and their workplaces. This section also includes a few extra details and notes.
